title: Generated artifact evaluation and mutation permission split

phases.objective: Keep pull-request generated-artifact evaluation read-only while granting bounded write authority only to the governed exact-head workflow_dispatch operation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Canonical test manifest runner contract test
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The PR evaluator has read-only contents permission and no push path, while the separate governed apply workflow requires exact-head input, typed confirmation, and bounded contents/actions write permissions.
steps: Load the PR generated-artifact evaluation workflow.
Assert read-only contents permission, non-persisted credentials, and absence of git push.
Load the governed generated-artifact apply workflow.
Assert workflow_dispatch-only mutation authority with contents/actions write permissions.
Assert exact expected-head SHA and typed confirmation remain required.
Run the same validator through the platform engine validator runner.
assertions: Pull-request evaluation cannot mutate repository contents.
Mutation authority is isolated behind the registered governed workflow_dispatch operation.
The validator remains discoverable in the canonical test manifest.
No migration, deployment, provider mutation, or secret access is performed.

phases.objective: Retain the permission split as generated-artifact workflows evolve.
Exercise malformed dispatch inputs and permission regressions without granting pull-request write access.
Observe the split on representative generated-artifact refresh operations.
Require the validated permission split for protected-branch merge readiness.
